scope: Verified official runtime, freshly regenerated uninstalled launch draft, real fixture gateway only.

limits: Point-in-time filesystem and caller-supplied service inventory only; recheck immediately before activation.
Metadata validates key length and permissions, not key content or equality with container keys.
Node executable ancestry is checked; dynamic libraries and operating-system loader configuration are not inspected.
Same UID and root remain trusted; later filesystem/service changes are not locked.
Existing sockets are always refused; explicit listener and stale-socket recovery is required.

launchDraft.label: com.knolstory.client-proof-gateway
limits: Draft does not verify future log/key/socket directory permissions or install a job.
After a crash, verify listener absence and owned stale socket before manual recovery; this draft does not delete sockets or provide automatic crash recovery.
Actual production key/mount equality, service installation and recovery remain separately gated.
Direct dependency review trusts macOS system libraries/loader; no complete runtime memory attestation.
Fresh service absence does not lock the label or prove future launchd environment.
Fixture IP/session are synthetic; no actual Cloudflare/Tunnel UDS or provider upload proof.
